test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Restaurants are_______ to new ways of attracting customers these days.
solution:
The correct answer is "**adapting**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Displaying**: put (something) in a prominent place in order that it may readily be seen.
 
• **Existing**: in existence or operation at the current time. 
 
• **Living**: an income sufficient to live on or the means of earning it.
 
• **Adapting**: make (something) suitable for a new use or purpose; modify.
 
• The meaning of adapting goes with the meaning of the sentence.
 
• The restaurant is adjusting to the new ways of attracting customers.

**The correct sentence is**: *Restaurants are_**adapting__**_ to new ways of attracting customers these days.*

**Hence, the correct answer is option 4**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

__
 
• आइए दिए गए शब्दों के अर्थ को देखें।
 
• **अनुकूलन(adapting)**: एक नए उपयोग या उद्देश्य के लिए उपयुक्त (कुछ) बनाना; संशोधित करें।
 
• **प्रदर्शित करना(displaying)**: (किसी चीज को) प्रमुख स्थान पर रखना ताकि वह आसानी से दिखाई दे।
 
• 
 मौजूदा(existing): वर्तमान समय में अस्तित्व या संचालन में।
 
 
• 
 जीवन यापन(living): एक आय पर रहने के लिए पर्याप्त आय या इसे अर्जित करने का साधन।
